correctness.rationale: Exhaustive classification of length-four local quotients gives the central projective plane and all curvilinear tangent affine planes. Multiplicity three imposes exactly the f3 tangent equation. Explicit Plücker minors (0,-B,1,B²,-B,-C) give each embedded quadric cone with its entire boundary line in the plane; no other ideals exist. Three squares of distinct tangent equations form independent points on a Veronese conic. Exact symbolic and finite-field verification checks corroborate key formulas; characteristic zero full proof is algebraic. Nilpotents and intersection multiplicities are excluded.
